title: Investigating Algorithmic Bias in YouTube Shorts

bias_targets.methodology: Using Generative AI models to classify recommended video topics across browsing depths to measure content drift from politically sensitive and serious topics (e.g., South China Sea dispute, Taiwan election) toward unrelated entertainment content.

Classifying the emotional tone (joy, sadness, anger, neutral, fear) of video titles and transcripts using LLMs to observe algorithmic preferences, specifically the systematic shift toward joyful or neutral content and away from negative emotions.

Tracking user engagement metrics (log-transformed views, likes, and comments) across recommendation depths to evaluate whether the algorithm disproportionately promotes high-engagement, viral videos over niche content.
